verdict.rationale: LobeHub runs real, browsable registries: a Skills marketplace listing 334k skills and an MCP server directory of about 100k entries ranked by activity and stability. It documents a one-command install (`npx -y @lobehub/market-cli skills install ... --agent cursor`). The desktop app can also install and run MCP connectors, and Agents can be added to a Workspace from the marketplace. missing for 10: explicit evidence of in-app one-click install of a registry skill or plugin into LobeChat itself (the CLI example targets Cursor), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the install flow.
